costs.comparability: Same counts/information and estimands, different guarantees/output sizes; ordinary arithmetic is not a certificate verifier.
costs.durable_workflow_scope: Separately measured fresh Python process, imports, input reads/digests, calculations, JSON serialization and exclusive fsync/hard-link publication. Contract uses count, certificate and basis-verifier CLI functions in one process and publishes three files; direct publishes one. Parent temporary-directory creation/deletion and result-file stat calls are outside timing. Not three separate CLI processes.
costs.excluded: Interpreter startup/imports, inventory scan, process/RSS/native allocation, durable publication/fsync/link, model/detector/task execution.
costs.included: Warm in-process input read, strict JSON decode, arithmetic and JSON serialization; contract additionally validates identity/partition, hashes, certifies and re-derives.

archived_format_issues.handling: Tagged for structural inspection only; original file unchanged, numerical outcome unresolved.

inventory.scope: Candidate artifact JSON/JSONL/CSV only; source records are tasks, not detector events.
